title: Drupal 7 behind Cloudflare: don't break admin or images
lede: Flip the orange cloud on a Drupal 7 site and two things break first: the editor login loops, and image styles 404. Here's the settings.php and cache-rule playbook that holds.
hero_alt: Overhead photo: handwritten Cloudflare cache-rule sheet, settings.php printout, Drupal 7 folder tab, wax seal on envelope.
